correctness.rationale: The exact conditional law follows by a bijective generalized Prüfer code and the r-Stirling partition count. The fixed-r Stirling row is real-rooted with simple negative zeros by an explicit interlacing recurrence, hence log-concave. The deletion identity then gives strict adjacent likelihood-ratio comparisons; support boundaries and the permutation case are treated separately. Independent direct map enumeration through n=6 and 114389 exact checks corroborate all steps. Finite checking is not used as an infinite proof.
